source_refs.section: Run the Windows printer troubleshooter; General troubleshooting, Step 1
source_refs.applicability: Windows; the troubleshooter step is for Windows 11 only and is skipped on older Windows versions
source_refs.app: Get Help app and printer power
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Sometimes power cycling your printer can resolve the issue.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Windows: On Windows 11, run the troubleshooter: Open the printer troubleshooter in the Get Help app. Skip this on older Windows versions. Step 1, power cycle: Power off the printer, disconnect it, wait about 30 seconds, reconnect it, and power it on.

source_refs.title: Fix printer connection and printing problems in Windows | Microsoft Support
source_refs.applicability: Windows; wired and wireless printers take different checks
source_refs.app: USB cable, Wi-Fi and printer status
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Make sure that the printer's USB cable is properly connected from the printer to your PC.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Windows: Step 2, connection check: Wired: confirm the USB cable is firmly connected to the PC. Wireless: confirm the printer's wireless option is on and that the PC is on the same network. If the status reads 'Printer in error state,' check for low paper or ink, an open cover, or a paper jam.
source_refs.extraction_method: WebFetch of the official page on 2026-11-17; the connection check branches from General troubleshooting Step 2; 'On Windows:' prefix added; straight apostrophes.

source_refs.title: Fix printer connection and printing problems in Windows | Microsoft Support
source_refs.section: General troubleshooting, Steps 3 and 4 (reinstall and driver)
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Select the Remove button. Then confirm you're sure you want to remove this device by selecting Yes.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Windows: Step 3, reinstall: Go to Start > Settings > Bluetooth & Devices > Printers & scanners. Select the printer, select Remove, then select Yes. Then select Add device or Refresh. If the printer doesn't appear, select Add manually. Step 4, driver: If the printer still fails, install the latest driver from the manufacturer or the linked driver guide.
